---
title: "Vignettes"
description: "OpenRBQM package vignettes and documentation."
---

Vignettes and articles fetched from each OpenRBQM package, listed by package in
the same order as the [Packages](packages.qmd) tab.




## gsm.core

- [KRI Method](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.core/articles/KRIMethod.html) — This vignette outlines the statistical methods used to evaluate Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) in {gsm}.
- [Step-by-Step Analysis Workflow](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.core/articles/DataAnalysis.html) — This vignette walks users through the mechanics of the functions that produce all of the Analysis workflow output within the `{gsm.core}` package.
- [Data Model](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.core/articles/DataModel.html) — A vignette detailing the data model used in the gsm pipeline.
- [gsm Extensions](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.core/articles/gsmExtensions.html) — This vignette describes how to extend {gsm.core} by creating new 'modules', including metrics, reports and shiny apps that can be run using the standard gsm pipeline.

## gsm.mapping

- [Requesting New Domains or Variables](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.mapping/articles/add_new_domain_var.html) — Detailed instructions for adding mapping specifications for a new domain or a new variable in an existing domain.
- [Mapping Specifications](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.mapping/articles/mapping_spec.html) — A Vignette that details all mapping specifications for all domains in {gsm.mapping}
